isolation.problem: the new launcher-group-kill fixture scanned the global private report directory and accepted the first new nonempty JSON, so a concurrent gate could supply a foreign report
isolation.fix: the launcher subprocess is spawned with TMPDIR set to the fixture directory, so its guardian private report directory is private to this test; the fixture scans only that directory
isolation.scope: test isolation only; deadline expectations and the unknown-flake risk are unchanged; expectStopped is not weakened or polled

contract.reportPhase: decision = provisional terminal reason recorded before destructive cleanup; complete = final record after the loop exits
contract.ownedTreeStopped: true only when exited && !live was observed; false while a launched owned tree is still present; null only for pre-root error receipts
contract.runHeavyGate: a decision record, a false stopped state, or PASS with null stopped state is classified as failure, preserving the supervisor reason; only complete + ownedTreeStopped true may be PASS
contract.consumerRule: provisional/missing evidence is INCOMPLETE or FAIL, never PASS or observed OOM
contract.effectiveExit: a PASS rejected for incomplete evidence becomes FAIL with a nonzero effective exitCode (1 when the supervisor exited 0); the raw supervisor code is preserved as supervisorExitCode; original terminal reason unchanged. Complete PASS 0 / FAIL 1 / RESOURCE_LIMIT 73 / LOCK_BUSY 75 keep the supervisor exit.
contract.classificationSeam: classifyGateResult(record, supervisorExitCode, command, settings, reportPath) is the single exported record-to-result transformation used by runHeavyGate, so guardHeavyGate and the CLI consume the effective nonzero exit.
contract.label: classifyGateResult defaults an absent settings.label to 'heavy command', matching normalize; the exported result label is always a string.
